CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS history_export_schedules (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  scheduleType ENUM('DAILY', 'WEEKLY', 'MONTHLY') DEFAULT 'DAILY' NOT NULL,
  scheduleTime VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT '08:00' NOT NULL,
  scheduleDayOfWeek INT,
  scheduleDayOfMonth INT,
  exportFormat ENUM('CSV', 'JSON', 'EXCEL', 'PDF') DEFAULT 'CSV' NOT NULL,
  factoryId INT,
  workshopId INT,
  lineId INT,
  machineId INT,
  productModelId INT,
  resultFilter ENUM('ALL', 'OK', 'NG', 'NTF') DEFAULT 'ALL' NOT NULL,
  timeRangeType ENUM('LAST_24H', 'LAST_7D', 'LAST_30D', 'LAST_MONTH', 'CUSTOM') DEFAULT 'LAST_24H' NOT NULL,
  customDays INT,
  recipients JSON NOT NULL,
  includeImages BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
  includeAnnotations BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  includeMeasurements BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  includeSummaryStats BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  isActive BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  lastRunAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  lastRunStatus ENUM('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'PENDING') DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  lastRunError TEXT,
  nextRunAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdBy INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_export_schedule_type (scheduleType),
  INDEX idx_export_schedule_active (isActive),
  INDEX idx_export_schedule_next (nextRunAt),
  INDEX idx_export_schedule_creator (createdBy)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS history_export_logs (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  scheduleId INT NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'PENDING', 'RUNNING') DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  recordCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  fileSize INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  fileUrl TEXT,
  recipientCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  deliveredCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  failedCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  errorMessage TEXT,
  startedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  completedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  processingTimeMs INT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_export_log_schedule (scheduleId),
  INDEX idx_export_log_status (status),
  INDEX idx_export_log_started (startedAt)
);
